records.description: 16 Bit designs, trains, and validates machine-learning algorithms to streamline the process of interpreting radiology images. With imaging data banks continually growing and the health system’s increasing reliance on medical-imaging services, radiologists have become a bottleneck in the overall delivery of healthcare. By augmenting medical analysis workflows with artificially intelligent tools, 16 Bit will help physicians diagnose and monitor disease by improving accuracy and efficiency.

In the clinical trial setting, only 8.2% of drugs tested for neurological diseases reach the clinical setting, relative to 15% of all drugs overall. This is largely due to the lack of biomarkers to characterize the heterogeneity of patients, as well as variable response to therapeutics. Accordingly, there is a critical unmet need for biomarkers of neurologic diseases. To address this gap, we have developed a software pipeline, CoveConnectTM, designed to derive biomarkers of neurologic diseases in clinical trial. By merging machine learning learning approaches with neuroscience expertise, CoveConnectTM closes the divide between data processing and neuroscience, enabling the neuroscience industry to effectively manage and comprehend data from MRIs and EEGs. As such, our solution is an essential tool in accelerating, de-risking, and advancing clinical trials in the Alzheimer’s setting.
